**Deforestation cannot be confirmed from the available evidence.** The data support approximately 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss within the asset in 2021, or 2.23% of its area.

Most of the loss area—68.1 hectares—was mapped as planted forest, and none was mapped as native forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting or other stand replacement; it does not by itself establish deforestation or a change in land use. The cause of the loss is unknown.
